findings.title: Newly admitted negative-infinite melting point can hang inverse bracket growth
findings.evidence: Set meltingTemperatureK=-INFINITY; mushyRangeK=20, solidSpecificHeatJkgK=1273, latentHeatJkg=1.16e6 and finite profile enthalpy (e.g. 1). Solidus/liquidus/hSolidus/hLiquidus and initial upper are -INFINITY. Both inverse early branches are false; H(upper)=-INFINITY < 1 and upper<20000 are true; upper*=1.5 remains -INFINITY forever. Removed parameter admission formerly rejected this value. This is a static proof, not execution.
findings.required_outcome: Ensure nonprogressing/nonfinite bracket growth reaches the original bounded inverse arithmetic and real publication without introducing a refusal/default result and without changing ordinary successful bracket steps or forty bisections.
